name: Crave Foster
source:
"...It can't be helped, I'll just have to protect the back of the captain who is full of openings."

The vice-captain of the crew of pirates. [url=/c42784]Jake's[/url] right hand man and childhood friend.
He's responsible for the management and finances of the pirate group. His specialty is negotiation especially using his logic to set things right.
However when the freewheeling Jake and [url=/c42786]Emilio[/url] mess around with him he shows a side that is quick to anger, he's the one person in the crew that isn't to be messed with.
